::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
AMD's largest R&D centre outside the US, significantly expanded after the Xilinx acquisition. India teams work on Ryzen, EPYC, Radeon, and Versal adaptive SoC product lines.
:::

## What does this firm design?

CPU (Ryzen, EPYC) and GPU (Radeon) design, adaptive computing platforms (Versal, inherited from Xilinx), and data centre accelerators. India engineers work across RTL design, verification, physical design, and emulation.
